# Neofect

> > Neofect develops smart neurorehabilitation devices and digital platforms for stroke recovery, brain injury, and hand rehabilitation using neuroplasticity-based therapy.

Neofect offers a comprehensive suite of FDA-cleared medical devices and software solutions for post-stroke and traumatic brain injury rehabilitation. The platform combines hardware (Smart Glove, Smart Board, Smart Pegboard, Smart Balance), mobile apps (Rehabit), and telehealth integration (Neofect TeleRehab) to enable both clinical and home-based therapy.

## Key Topics

## Core Products

- [Smart Glove](https://www.neofect.com/us/smart-glove): Smart Glove product page featuring neuroplasticity-based stroke rehabilitation technology.
- [Smart Board](https://www.neofect.com/us/smart-board): Smart Board product page for functional arm reaching and upper-limb rehabilitation.
- [Smart Pegboard](https://www.neofect.com/us/smart-pegboard): Smart Pegboard product page for hand dexterity and cognitive rehabilitation training.
- [Smart Balance](https://www.neofect.com/us/smart-balance): Smart Balance product page for post-stroke balance assessment and training.
- [Cognition](https://www.neofect.com/us/cognition): Neofect Cognition comprehensive program for cognitive rehabilitation after stroke or TBI.

## Digital Therapy Platforms

- [Rehabit](https://www.neofect.com/us/rehabit): Rehabit companion app for habit formation and self-managed stroke recovery.
- [Neofect TeleRehab](https://www.neofect.com/us/neofect-telerehab): Neofect TeleRehab HIPAA-compliant platform for remote PT/OT therapy integration.
